title: Santa's Favorite Dinker Pickleball Christmas Shirt, Funny Holiday Pickleball Sweatshirt for Players
description:
Everyone on the court knows who made the nice list. A Santa-hatted pickleball and a bold red plate that reads well even in a tiny photo.

Who it's for:
- Dinkers who play all year, snow or not
- Gift buyers for pickleball-obsessed parents, grandparents and friends
- Holiday tournaments and ugly-sweater socials

About the design:
A red 'DINKER' plate with a cream border so it pops on dark garments, topped with gold script and a festive pickleball.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Santa's Favorite Dinker design with a Santa-hatted pickleball and a red DINKER plate on a charcoal sweatshirt.
